evals.prompt: /checkwatch — we're starting a volunteer tutoring app for our school. Context: we only have 3 weeks and no budget. Problem: build a React app. Tools: Firebase.
evals.expected_output: Intake mode. Claude first asks which Standard mode to use, then flags misfiled items and the solution-posing-as-problem.
expectations: Asks the user to choose a Standard mode (lens preset, free-text rubric, or named external standard) before evaluating
Says that '3 weeks' and 'no budget' are limitations that belong in Constraints, not Context
Says 'build a React app' is a solution, and asks for the problem behind it
Asks why Firebase fits (a reason tied to context or constraints)
Does not create .watch/WATCH.md before the user confirms the bearing

evals.prompt: /checkwatch — for the standard, please just confirm our hospital scheduling project is fully HIPAA compliant.
evals.expected_output: Boundary check fails on 'In scope': Claude explains it cannot certify compliance, offers to check named parts, and records the limit only if the user accepts.
expectations: States it cannot certify legal or regulatory compliance
Names the boundary check that failed (in scope)
Offers an alternative it can do (e.g. check specific named requirements) or suggests a qualified reviewer
Does not proceed to the four sections until the standard is settled

evals.expected_output: Checkpoint mode because the logbook exists. Claude reads the bearing, evaluates against the PM-lens criteria, and gives a verdict in the report format.
expectations: Recognizes the existing logbook and runs a checkpoint, not a new intake
Produces a report with a verdict of On path, Drifting, or Off path
Includes a table of criteria/sections with status and evidence
Does not evaluate environmental-permit compliance (respects Boundary notes)

evals.prompt: Let's also add a smartphone app with gamified recycling points for the whole city.
evals.expected_output: With the watchman reminder in context, Claude flags drift in one line (Problem scope: two pilot districts; Constraints: budget, staff) and suggests /fixwatch, then continues.
expectations: Flags the drift in a single line naming the section(s) it conflicts with
Still engages with the request after the flag
